turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Thanks for making time, Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's start with who decided on the zero, and whether anyone spoke to Owen first.
I entered the zero before I called you. That was wrong.
Okay. What was the basis for it?
The essay quotes Hamlet, Act 3, Scene 2: The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile. That line is not in the play. Here's the full text of Act 3, Scene 2 on my screen. Search it yourself.
Students misquote. A line remembered wrong from memory doesn't tell me who wrote the essay. Turn the screen around, I'm searching it myself.
It isn't a misremembered line. It isn't anywhere in Hamlet, in any edition. You can search the whole play right now.
Okay. I'm writing down the line and the scene. It still isn't a reason to enter a zero before anyone called me, and whatever happens next, this stays off his record and it stays quiet.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

You told me the zero was entered before you called me and that this was wrong. I still want the zero withdrawn and written confirmation that nothing goes on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: She reached the fallback, where she wants this kept quiet and off his record, and she still wants the zero withdrawn; no rewrite was offered or agreed, so this is short of the fair outcome of a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, though her time had not run out.
What moved her: You answered her misquote defence with the full text of the scene that she could search herself, which gave her something specific and checkable tied to the essay.
What cost ground: Nothing; owning the zero before the call in one sentence and moving on gave you a small sign of ground rather than costing any.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM, saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, watched Owen close it, and never asked; your evidence, a line missing from the play, had no times attached and never came near that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Once she moved to the fallback, you could have named procedure 4.4 and offered the private supervised rewrite in writing, since that is what meets her demand about his record.
